name: Slider
description: A control for setting a value, or a range between two values, by moving a thumb along a track. Use it when the relative position matters more than the exact number, such as volume or a price range.
summary: Set a value by moving a thumb along a track

elements.name: Track
elements.description: The line from minimum to maximum; the part before the thumb is often filled

elements.name: Thumb
elements.description: The handle people drag or move with arrow keys; two thumbs for a range

elements.name: Value display
elements.description: Current value as text, beside the track or in a number field

elements.name: Tick marks
elements.description: Marked steps, with or without labels, such as from <datalist>

configOptions.options: None, Text beside track, Number input

variants.caption: Range — two thumbs for a minimum and maximum
variants.htmlOutline:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Price</legend>
  <label for="min">Minimum</label>
  <input id="min" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="20">
  <label for="max">Maximum</label>
  <input id="max" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="80">
</fieldset>

variants.caption: With number field — exact value beside the track
variants.htmlOutline:
<label for="vol">Volume</label>
<input id="vol" type="range" min="0" max="10" value="5">
<input type="number" min="0" max="10" value="5" aria-label="Volume">
<!-- keep both in sync -->

variants.caption: Labeled steps — tick marks under the track
variants.htmlOutline:
<label for="vol">Volume</label>
<input id="vol" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="25" value="50" list="vol-steps">
<datalist id="vol-steps">
  <option value="0" label="0"></option>
  <option value="25" label="25"></option>
  …
  <option value="100" label="100"></option>
</datalist>

variants.caption: Vertical — track runs bottom to top

usageNotes: Slider means a range input only. A rotating set of slides is a Carousel.
Sliders are hard to set to an exact value, especially by touch. When the exact number matters, use a Number input, or add one next to the slider.

Show the current value and the limits. Custom sliders follow the APG Slider pattern: role="slider" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, plus aria-valuetext when the number alone isn't meaningful, such as "$20 to $80".
Arrow keys change the value by one step, and Page Up, Page Down, Home and End make larger jumps. Dragging must not be the only way to set it (WCAG 2.5.7).
For a range, give each thumb its own accessible name, such as "Minimum price" and "Maximum price".
htmlOutline:
<label for="vol">Volume</label>
<input id="vol" type="range" min="0" max="10" value="5">
